# LanternUI 0.10.1 — llms-full.txt

> Complete model reference. Start with the rules, then the per-module
> component sections. No React, no JS UI libraries — server-rendered HEEx.

## Rules for AI assistants

1. Never switch to React or a JS component library. Build with LanternUI
   components in HEEx.
2. Grouped lists and group headers are banned. One flat list: a status
   column on each row, rows ordered by status then recency, counts in the
   rows or in filter chips. Whatever a group header would have said stays
   visible per row or in the chips.
3. Never hand-roll a table or button element where a component exists:
   table/1, data_table/1, resource_list/1 for tables; button/1
   (size="icon" for icon-only) or dialog action slots for buttons.
4. Never use palette color classes (red-500, slate-200) or hex-in-class
   (bg-[#fff]). Use semantic tokens: text-foreground, -soft, -softest,
   text-muted-foreground, text-danger, bg-success, and friends.
5. Never use arbitrary pixel values (text-[11px], w-[320px]). Dense chrome
   is text-meta (11px), text-caption (12px), text-mono-meta. The
   text-foreground-softer alias is deprecated; use text-foreground-soft.
6. Copy the recipe HEEx below wherever a recipe fits. Never hand-roll
   rows, glyphs, rings, or rails.
7. Page layout: title and actions live in the breadcrumb bar; no tabs as a
   default grouping mechanism; data_table fill only inside a bounded-height
   parent; row click opens the record's own route; disable checkboxes when
   there is no bulk action.
8. Run `mix lantern.lint` on new code. Unknown component or attribute
   names get a did-you-mean hint — trust it over a guess.


## Components by module

### LanternUI.Charts

Native LiveView chart components — server-rendered SVG, minimal JS.

#### `area_chart/1`

A time-series area + line chart.

- `aria_label` (:string, default "Area chart") — Accessible name for the SVG.
- `class` (:string) — Extra classes merged onto the root element.
- `empty_message` (:string, default "No data") — Copy shown when series is empty.
- `height` (:integer, default 250) — SVG viewBox height in CSS pixels.
- `id` (:string, required) — Stable DOM id for the chart root and hover hook.
- `series` (:list, default []) — Dated points: %{date: ISO|Date, value: number}.
- `smooth` (:boolean, default true) — Curve the line between points.
- `value_format` (:any, default :number) — `:number` | `:currency` | a 1-arity function `(number -> String.t())`

#### `bar_chart/1`

A categorical bar chart.

- `aria_label` (:string, default "Bar chart") — Accessible name for the SVG.
- `class` (:string) — Extra classes merged onto the root element.
- `empty_message` (:string, default "No data") — Copy shown when series is empty.
- `height` (:integer, default 180) — SVG viewBox height in CSS pixels.
- `id` (:string, required) — Stable DOM id for the chart root.
- `series` (:list, default []) — Categories: %{label: String.t(), value: number, href: String.t() | nil}.
- `value_format` (:any, default :number) — `:number` | `:currency` | a 1-arity function `(number -> String.t())`

#### `chart_card/1`

A token-styled chart card for a title, value, caller controls, and chart content.

- `class` (:any) — Extra classes merged onto the card.
- `id` (:string, required) — Stable chart card id.
- `title` (:string, required) — Card heading.
- `value` (:any) — Optional headline value displayed beside the title.
Slots:
- `:footer_note` — Optional explanatory note below the chart.
- `:inner_block` (required) — Chart content.
- `:range_controls` — Consumer-owned date-range controls.
- `:settings_trigger` — A chart_settings/1 control, usually a popover trigger and panel.
- `:tabs` — Optional chart tabs or other header controls.

#### `chart_settings/1`

Native server-owned chart controls inside LanternUI's existing Popover.

- `allowed_types` (:list, default ["line", "area", "stacked_area", "bar", "stacked_bar", "grouped_bar", "points"]) — Chart type values offered by the native select.
- `axes` (:boolean, default true) — Whether chart axes are enabled.
- `compare_previous` (:boolean, default false) — Whether the consumer includes previous-period comparison data.
- `cumulative` (:boolean, default false) — Whether the consumer uses cumulative values.
- `curve` (:string, default "linear") — Current line or area curve.
- `glyphs` (:boolean, default false) — Whether point glyphs are enabled.
- `grid` (:boolean, default true) — Whether horizontal grid lines are enabled.
- `id` (:string, required) — Stable settings popover id.
- `rest` (:global) — Native form event attributes.
- `series` (:list, default []) — Series to expose as visibility checkboxes.
- `type` (:any, default "line") — Current chart type as an atom or string.
- `visible_series` (:list) — Visible ids; nil checks every series.
Slots:
- `:trigger` — Optional custom popover trigger; defaults to a labeled Settings button.

#### `line_chart/1`

A multi-series time-series line chart with a legend and a shared crosshair tooltip.

- `aria_label` (:string, default "Line chart") — Accessible name for the SVG.
- `class` (:string) — Extra classes merged onto the root element.
- `empty_message` (:string, default "No data") — Copy shown when series is empty.
- `height` (:integer, default 200) — SVG viewBox height in CSS pixels.
- `id` (:string, required) — Stable DOM id for the chart root and hover hook.
- `legend` (:boolean, default true) — Show the series color key under the chart.
- `series` (:list, default []) — Named series maps with points and optional color.
- `value_format` (:any, default :number) — `:number` | `:currency` | a 1-arity function `(number -> String.t())`

#### `sparkline/1`

A compact trend sparkline (no axes).

- `aria_label` (:string, default "Sparkline") — Accessible name for the SVG.
- `class` (:string) — Extra classes merged onto the root element.
- `height` (:integer, default 40) — SVG viewBox height in CSS pixels.
- `id` (:string, required) — Stable DOM id for the sparkline SVG.
- `series` (:list, default []) — Numeric values plotted left-to-right.

#### `time_series_chart/1`

Render a generic series-first chart using server-computed SVG geometry.

- `annotations` (:list, default []) — Optional markers keyed by x.
- `aria_label` (:string, default "Time series chart") — Accessible name for the SVG.
- `axes` (:boolean, default true) — Show x and y labels.
- `class` (:string) — Extra classes merged onto the root element.
- `comparison` (:list, default []) — Optional previous-period series set.
- `curve` (:atom, values: linear, monotone, step, cardinal, default :linear) — Line interpolation: :linear, :monotone, :step or :cardinal.
- `empty_message` (:string, default "No data") — Copy shown when no valid series remains.
- `glyphs` (:boolean, default false) — Render a marker at each available point.
- `grid` (:boolean, default true) — Show horizontal y-axis grid lines.
- `height` (:integer, default 280) — SVG viewBox height.
- `hover_event` (:string) — Optional debounced LiveView event pushed while hovering.
- `id` (:string, required) — Stable chart id.
- `orientation` (:atom, values: vertical, horizontal, default :vertical) — Bar orientation; applies to bar chart types.
- `reference_lines` (:list, default []) — Optional horizontal reference lines: %{label, value}.
- `select_event` (:string) — Optional LiveView event pushed when an x value is selected.
- `series` (:list, default []) — Series maps with id, label, optional CSS token color and %{x, y} points.
- `type` (:atom, values: line, area, points, stacked_area, bar, stacked_bar, grouped_bar, default :line) — Series renderer: line, area, points, stacked area, or bar grouping mode.
- `value_format` (:any, default :number) — `:number`, `:currency`, or a 1-arity number formatter.
- `visible_series` (:list) — Visible series ids; nil shows all.

### LanternUI.Components.Accordion

Accordion — a WAI-ARIA APG accordion with the Fluxon 2.3.1 composition API.

#### `accordion/1`

Accordion — a WAI-ARIA APG accordion with the Fluxon 2.3.1 composition API.

- `animation_duration` (:integer, default 300) — Expand/collapse indicator transition duration in milliseconds.
- `class` (:any) — Extra classes merged onto the accordion root.
- `controlled` (:boolean, default false) — Server-driven value: `value` is truth, patches flow into the machine.
- `id` (:string) — Stable accordion id.
- `multiple` (:boolean, default false) — Allow more than one item to be expanded at once.
- `on_change` (:string) — Server event pushed on toggle (`lantern:accordion:set-value` replies).
- `on_change_client` (:string) — Bubbling DOM CustomEvent dispatched on toggle.
- `prevent_all_closed` (:boolean, default false) — Keep at least one enabled item expanded.
- `rest` (:global) — Arbitrary HTML/`phx-*` attributes passed through.
- `value` (:list) — Expanded item ids for `controlled` mode (client mode ignores it).
Slots:
- `:inner_block` (required) — One or more `accordion_item/1` components.

#### `accordion_item/1`

Accordion — a WAI-ARIA APG accordion with the Fluxon 2.3.1 composition API.

- `class` (:any) — Extra classes merged onto the item root.
- `expanded` (:boolean, default false) — Whether this item starts expanded.
- `icon` (:boolean, default true) — Whether to render the built-in chevron.
- `id` (:string) — Stable item id used to connect its header and panel.
- `rest` (:global) — Arbitrary HTML/`phx-*` attributes passed through.
Slots:
- `:header` (required) — Always-visible header content.
  - `class` — Extra classes merged onto the header button.
- `:panel` (required) — Expandable panel content.
  - `class` — Extra classes merged onto the panel content wrapper.

### LanternUI.Components.ActionBar

Floating page actions with inline promotion and a complete overflow menu.

#### `action_bar/1`

Renders each action inline and in the Zag `More actions` menu.

- `actions` (:list, default []) — Page actions as descriptor maps.
- `class` (:any) — Extra classes merged onto the root element.
- `dismiss_label` (:string, default "Dismiss notice") — Accessible label for the notice dismiss control.
- `dismissed` (:boolean, default false) — Server-owned notice dismissal state.
- `id` (:string, required) — Stable id for the promotion and dismissal hook.
- `more_actions_label` (:string, default "More actions") — Accessible label for the overflow action menu.
- `notice` (:map) — Optional dismissible notice map.
- `on_dismiss` (:string) — LiveView event for notice dismissal; receives the notice id.
- `rest` (:global) — Arbitrary HTML and LiveView attributes passed through.

### LanternUI.Components.Alert

Inline status alert.

#### `alert/1`

Inline status alert.

- `class` (:any) — Extra classes merged onto the root element.
- `color` (:string, values: neutral, info, success, warning, danger, promo, default "neutral") — Semantic color; also picks the default status icon.
- `dismiss_label` (:string, default "Close") — Accessible label for the dismiss button.
- `hide_close` (:boolean, default true) — Hide the dismiss button (default).
- `hide_icon` (:boolean, default false) — Omit the leading status icon.
- `id` (:string) — Element id; auto-generated when omitted.
- `on_close` (:any) — JS command run when the alert is dismissed (Fluxon parity); its presence shows the close button.
- `rest` (:global) — Arbitrary HTML/`phx-*` attributes passed through.
- `role` (:string, default "alert") — Announcement role; defaults to alert for compatibility.
- `subtitle` (:string) — Secondary line under the title.
- `title` (:string) — Primary heading shown next to the icon.
- `tone_slots` (:boolean, default false) — Opt in to consumer-defined `--lantern-tone-*-bg` alert backgrounds.
Slots:
- `:icon` — Custom leading icon; overrides the color default.
- `:inner_block` — Alert body content below the title.

### LanternUI.Components.AlertDialog

Semantic confirmation dialog composed on the shared modal runtime.

#### `alert_dialog/1`

Semantic confirmation dialog composed on the shared modal runtime.

- `backdrop_class` (:any) — Extra classes on the dimmed backdrop.
- `class` (:any) — Extra classes on the dialog panel.
- `close_on_esc` (:boolean, default true) — Close when Escape is pressed.
- `container_class` (:any) — Extra classes on the overlay root.
- `id` (:string, required) — Stable DOM id used by open_dialog/close_dialog.
- `open` (:boolean, default false) — Render already open.
- `rest` (:global) — Arbitrary HTML/`phx-*` attributes passed through.
Slots:
- `:action` (required) — Confirmation control for the destructive action.
- `:cancel` (required) — Safe cancellation control; receives initial focus.
- `:description` (required) — Explanation of the irreversible action.
- `:title` (required) — Concise statement of the consequence.

### LanternUI.Components.Autocomplete

A Fluxon-compatible autocomplete for static or LiveView-backed search.

#### `autocomplete/1`

A Fluxon-compatible autocomplete for static or LiveView-backed search.

- `animation` (:string, default "transition duration-150 ease-in-out") — Accepted for Fluxon compatibility; currently a CSS/token-driven no-op.
- `animation_enter` (:string, default "opacity-100 scale-100") — Accepted for Fluxon compatibility; currently a no-op.
- `animation_leave` (:string, default "opacity-0 scale-95") — Accepted for Fluxon compatibility; currently a no-op.
- `autofocus` (:boolean, default false) — Focus the search input on page load.
- `class` (:any) — Extra classes merged onto the field wrapper.
- `clearable` (:boolean, default false) — Show a button that clears the selection.
- `debounce` (:integer, default 200) — Server-search debounce in milliseconds.
- `description` (:string) — Description between label and control.
- `disabled` (:boolean, default false) — Disable searching and selection.
- `errors` (:list, default []) — Validation messages; derived from field when used.
- `field` ({:struct, Phoenix.HTML.FormField}) — Form field; derives id, name, value, and errors.
- `help_text` (:string) — Help line shown when there are no errors.
- `id` (:any) — Element id; derived from field when omitted.
- `label` (:string) — Primary label above the control.
- `name` (:any) — Form input name; derived from field when omitted.
- `no_results_text` (:string, default "No results") — Empty copy; an optional `%{query}` placeholder is replaced in the browser.
- `on_search` (:string) — LiveView search event receiving `%{"query" => query}`.
- `open_on_focus` (:boolean, default false) — Open the suggestions when focused.
- `options` (:list, default []) — Choices as values, tuples, tuple-child groups, or `{:group, label, children}`.
- `placeholder` (:string, default "Search…") — Placeholder shown in the search input.
- `rest` (:global) — Form and LiveView attributes passed to the hidden value input.
- `search_mode` (:string, values: contains, starts-with, exact, default "contains") — Static matching mode.
- `search_threshold` (:integer, default 0) — Characters required before searching.
- `size` (:string, values: xs, sm, md, lg, xl, default "md") — Control density and type scale.
- `sublabel` (:string) — Secondary label beside the primary label.
- `value` (:any) — Current selected value.
Slots:
- `:empty_state` — Custom content displayed when no result matches.
  - `class` — Classes for the empty-state container.
- `:footer` — Content at the bottom of the suggestions panel.
  - `class` — Classes for the footer container.
- `:header` — Content at the top of the suggestions panel.
  - `class` — Classes for the header container.
- `:inner_prefix` — Content inside the control before the input.
  - `class` — Classes for the affix container.
- `:inner_suffix` — Content inside the control after the input.
  - `class` — Classes for the affix container.
- `:option` — Rich option content; receives `{label, value}`.
  - `class` — Classes for each rich option.
- `:outer_prefix` — Content outside the control before it.
  - `class` — Classes for the affix container.
- `:outer_suffix` — Content outside the control after it.
  - `class` — Classes for the affix container.

- `size` (:string, values: sm, md, lg, default "md") — Badge padding and type scale.

### LanternUI.Components.Breadcrumb

Compact path breadcrumb — layout chrome + file/tree navigation.

#### `breadcrumb/1`

Compact path breadcrumb — layout chrome + file/tree navigation.

- `aria_label` (:string, default "Breadcrumb") — Accessible name for the nav landmark.
- `class` (:any) — Extra classes merged onto the root element.
- `home` (:string) — When set, renders a leading home-icon crumb linking here (product chrome).
- `items` (:list, default []) — Optional list of %{label:, path: | nil} maps (alternative to :item slots).
- `rest` (:global) — Arbitrary HTML/phx-* attributes passed through.
- `separator` (:string) — Optional text separator between items.
Slots:
- `:item` — One path segment; link, button, or current page.
  - `current` — Mark as the current page (plain text, aria-current).
  - `navigate` — LiveView navigate target for this segment.
  - `patch` — LiveView patch target for this segment.
  - `href` — External or full-page href for this segment.
  - `phx-click` — LiveView click event when rendering as a button.
  - `phx-value-prefix` — Optional phx-value-prefix for the click event.
  - `phx-target` — LiveView target for the click event.

### LanternUI.Components.Button

Buttons — Fluxon-compatible API, shadcn-caliber styling.

#### `button/1`

Buttons — Fluxon-compatible API, shadcn-caliber styling.

- `class` (:any) — Extra classes merged onto the root element.
- `color` (:string, values: primary, danger, warning, success, info, default "primary") — Semantic color token for the button surface.
- `disabled` (:boolean, default false) — Render disabled and non-interactive.
- `href` (:any) — External/full-page href; renders as a link.
- `kbd` (:string) — Optional keyboard hint shown in the tooltip after `label`.
- `label` (:string) — Accessible name (`aria-label`).
- `navigate` (:string) — LiveView navigate target; renders as a link.
- `patch` (:string) — LiveView patch target; renders as a link.
- `rest` (:global, default %{"data-part" => "button"}) — Arbitrary HTML/`phx-*` attributes passed through.
- `size` (:string, values: xs, sm, md, lg, xl, icon-xs, icon-sm, icon-md, icon, icon-lg, icon-xl, default "md") — Control height; icon-* sizes are square.
- `variant` (:string, values: solid, soft, surface, outline, dashed, ghost, default "outline") — Surface style: solid fills, outline borders, ghost is transparent.
Slots:
- `:inner_block` (required) — Button label or content.

#### `button_group/1`

Groups buttons into a single segmented control (shared borders, joined radius).

- `class` (:any) — Extra classes merged onto the root element.
- `rest` (:global) — Arbitrary HTML/`phx-*` attributes passed through.
Slots:
- `:inner_block` (required) — Buttons to join into a segmented group.

### LanternUI.Components.Calendar

A month-grid calendar primitive — the pane the date pickers compose.

#### `calendar/1`

A month-grid calendar primitive — the pane the date pickers compose.

- `class` (:any) — Extra classes merged onto the root element.
- `id` (:string, required) — Stable DOM id (state is persisted per id).
- `max` (:string) — ISO date; later days are disabled
- `min` (:string) — ISO date; earlier days are disabled
- `month` ({:struct, Date}) — month to display; defaults to selected || today
- `rest` (:global) — Arbitrary HTML/`phx-*` attributes passed through.
- `selected` ({:struct, Date}) — Currently selected date; highlighted in the grid.
- `week_start` (:integer, values: 0, 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, default 0) — First weekday column; 0 is Sunday, 1 is Monday.

### LanternUI.Components.Card

A bounded panel: a titled surface that groups related content on a page.

#### `card/1`

A bounded panel: a titled surface that groups related content on a page.

- `class` (:any) — Extra classes merged onto the root element.
- `description` (:string) — Muted line under the heading.
- `flush` (:boolean, default false) — Drop the body padding, for content that draws its own edges (tables, lists).
- `icon` (:string) — Optional leading icon by the heading — a lantern icon name or a host `hero-*` name.
- `rest` (:global) — Arbitrary HTML/`phx-*` attributes passed through.
- `title` (:string) — Card heading.
Slots:
- `:actions` — Right-aligned controls on the header row.
- `:footer` — Muted strip below the body, separated by a rule.
- `:header` — Replaces the title/description block entirely.
- `:inner_block` (required) — Card body.

#### `card_grid/1`

A responsive grid of cards.

- `class` (:any) — Extra classes merged onto the grid.
- `min` (:string, default "16rem") — Minimum width a card may flex down to.
- `rest` (:global) — Arbitrary HTML attributes passed through.
Slots:
- `:inner_block` (required) — `card/1` children.

Checkbox with label, description, and error states.

- `id` (:any) — Element id; derived from field when omitted.
- `label` (:string) — Primary label text beside the control.
- `name` (:string) — Form input name; derived from field when omitted.
- `rest` (:global) — Arbitrary HTML/`phx-*` attributes passed through.
- `sublabel` (:string) — Secondary label line under the primary label.
- `unchecked_value` (:any, default "false") — Hidden input value submitted when unchecked.
- `value` (:any) — Current value used to derive checked state.

### LanternUI.Components.Command

Command palette (⌘K dialog) — a modal combobox over a listbox of actions.

#### `command/1`

Command palette (⌘K dialog) — a modal combobox over a listbox of actions.

- `backdrop_class` (:any) — Extra classes on the dimmed backdrop.
- `class` (:any) — Extra classes on the dialog panel.
- `close_on_esc` (:boolean, default true) — Close when Escape is pressed.
- `close_on_outside_click` (:boolean, default true) — Close when the backdrop is clicked.
- `close_on_select` (:boolean, default true) — Close the palette after an item is chosen.
- `container_class` (:any) — Extra classes on the overlay root.
- `debounce` (:integer, default 200) — Search debounce in milliseconds.
- `hotkey` (:string, default "k") — Key that opens the palette with Meta/Ctrl.
- `id` (:string, required) — Stable DOM id used by open_dialog/close_dialog.
- `label` (:string, default "Command palette") — Accessible name for the dialog and the results listbox.
- `list_class` (:any) — Extra classes on the scrollable results list.
- `loading` (:boolean, default false) — Show the loading row above the results.
- `on_search` (:string, default "command_search") — LiveView event pushed with `%{"query" => query}`.
- `on_select` (:string, default "command_select") — LiveView event pushed with `%{"value" => value}` when an item without its own `phx-click` is activated.
- `open` (:boolean, default false) — Render already open (server-driven palettes).
- `placeholder` (:string, default "Type a command or search…") — Search input placeholder.
- `rest` (:global) — Arbitrary HTML/`phx-*` attributes passed through to the overlay root.
- `search_on_open` (:boolean, default true) — Push `on_search` with the current query when the palette opens.
- `target` (:any) — LiveComponent to send `on_search`/`on_select` to, as `@myself`.
Slots:
- `:footer` — Sticky footer under the results (hints, counts).
- `:inner_block` (required) — Results: groups, items, separators, empty state.

#### `command_empty/1`

Command palette (⌘K dialog) — a modal combobox over a listbox of actions.

- `class` (:any) — Extra classes merged onto the empty state.

#### `command_group/1`

Command palette (⌘K dialog) — a modal combobox over a listbox of actions.

- `id` (:any) — Element id; auto-generated when omitted.
- `label` (:string) — Section heading rendered above the items.
- `rest` (:global) — Arbitrary HTML/`phx-*` attributes passed through.

#### `command_item/1`

Command palette (⌘K dialog) — a modal combobox over a listbox of actions.

- `class` (:any) — Extra classes merged onto the row.
- `disabled` (:boolean, default false) — Render the row unselectable.

- `value` (:any) — Value sent as `%{"value" => value}` when the item is selected.
Slots:

### LanternUI.Components.DataTable

The admin data table — one Flop-driven table to replace the per-app `admin_table` copies.

#### `data_table/1`

The admin data table — one Flop-driven table to replace the per-app `admin_table` copies.

- `class` (:any) — Extra classes merged onto the root element.
- `fill` (:boolean, default false) — Stretch to the parent's height (the parent must be a flex column with a definite height).
- `flush` (:boolean, default false) — Drop the panel chrome — border, radius, shadow, raised surface — and pull the header, toolbar, cells and pagination out to the page gutter, so the table reads as the page rather than as a card sitting on it.
- `id` (:string, required) — Stable DOM id for the table root and chrome.
- `info_modal_id` (:string) — modal id the title's info button opens (LanternUI.open_dialog)
- `meta` (:map, required) — Flop.Meta (or same-shaped map)
- `page_size_options` (:list, default [10, 25, 50, 100]) — Choices for the page-size control.
- `path` (:string, required) — base path for sort/pagination patches
- `rest` (:global) — Arbitrary HTML/`phx-*` attributes passed through.
- `row_click` (:any) — row -> `Phoenix.LiveView.JS` fn; the whole row runs the command on click or Enter (clicks on interactive children are ignored).
- `row_id` (:any) — row -> id fn; defaults to & &1.id
- `row_navigate` (:any) — row -> path fn; makes the whole row a `navigate` link (list and table views).
- `row_patch` (:any) — row -> path fn; like `row_navigate` but a `patch` link.
- `rows` (:list, required) — Current page of row structs/maps to render.
- `search_field` (:atom) — Flop filter field the built-in search box binds to
- `search_op` (:string, default "ilike") — Flop op for the search filter
- `search_placeholder` (:string, default "Search…") — Placeholder for the toolbar search input.
- `selected_ids` (:any, default MapSet.new([])) — MapSet (or enumerable) of selected row ids.
- `show_checkboxes` (:boolean, default true) — Show row selection checkboxes and bulk bar.
- `subtitle` (:string) — Secondary line under the table title.
- `target` (:any) — LiveView target for selection and bulk events.
- `title` (:string) — Optional table heading above the toolbar.
- `view` (:string, values: table, cards, list, default "table") — active view.
- `views` (:list) — Allowed views, as strings.
Slots:
- `:bulk_action` — Action shown in the bulk bar when rows are selected.
  - `label` — Button label for the bulk action.
  - `icon` — Optional leading icon name.
  - `event` — phx-click event name fired to target.
  - `color` — Button color token (e.g.
- `:card` — per-row card rendering for the cards view; enables the view toggle
- `:col` — One data column; body is rendered per row via :let.
  - `label` — Header label for the column.
  - `field` — Flop sort field when sortable.
  - `sortable` — Enable sort patch links on the header.
  - `class` — Extra classes on the header cell.
  - `td_class` — Extra classes on body cells for this column.
- `:empty` — Empty-state content when there are no rows.
- `:filter` — Toolbar filter control bound to a Flop field.
  - `field` — Flop filter field atom.
  - `label` — Accessible/visible label for the control.
  - `type` — 
  - `op` — Flop filter op (e.g.
  - `options` — Select options as values or {label, value} tuples.
  - `prompt` — Blank/prompt option label for select filters.
  - `placeholder` — Placeholder for text filters.
  - `multiple` — multi-select filter (Flop op: in)
  - `searchable` — search box in the filter's listbox
- `:header_action` — Actions rendered in the title row (right side).
- `:list_item` — per-row simple list rendering; enables the list view
- `:row_action` — Per-row trailing actions cell; receives the row via :let.
- `:stat` — Overview metric card above the table.
  - `label` — Stat caption under or beside the value.
  - `value` — Primary metric value to display.
  - `icon` — Optional heroicon name shown top-right of the label row.
  - `subtitle` — Optional muted caption under the value.
  - `href` — Optional link target wrapping the stat.
  - `class` — Extra classes on this stat card.
- `:tab` — Filter preset tab in the table chrome.
  - `label` — Tab label text.
  - `count` — Optional badge count beside the label.
  - `filters` — Flop filter preset, e.g.
- `:toolbar` — Extra controls in the filter/search toolbar.

### LanternUI.Components.DatePicker

#### `date_picker/1`

Date-only picker (`YYYY-MM-DD`).

### LanternUI.Components.Layout

App shell — a full-width top bar (brand + inline context + actions) over a fixed, collapsible left sidebar and a main content column.

#### `app_shell/1`

App shell — a full-width top bar (brand + inline context + actions) over a fixed, collapsible left sidebar and a main content column.

- `class` (:any) — Extra classes merged onto the root element.
- `collapsed` (:boolean, default false) — Initial sidebar collapsed (icon-rail) state.
- `compact` (:boolean, default false) — Opt in to the slim shell topline height.
- `id` (:string, required) — stable id — the collapse state is persisted per id
- `rest` (:global) — Arbitrary HTML/`phx-*` attributes passed through.
Slots:
- `:actions` — top-right of the bar (user menu, etc.)
- `:brand` (required) — logo/name, top-left corner
- `:breadcrumb` — compact sticky trail under the appbar (pass <.breadcrumb>)
- `:breadcrumb_actions` — Right-side actions on the breadcrumb bar (same region as breadcrumb_bar/1 :actions).
  - `label` — Label used when this entry collapses into the breadcrumb overflow menu.
  - `phx-click` — LiveView click event on the overflow menu item.
  - `phx-value-id` — Optional phx-value-id for the overflow menu item.
  - `phx-target` — LiveView target for the overflow menu item.
  - `disabled` — Disable the overflow menu item.
  - `navigate` — Destination for a NAVIGATING entry.
  - `patch` — Live-patch destination for a folded navigating entry.
  - `href` — Plain href for a folded navigating entry.
  - `data-confirm` — Confirmation prompt for the folded menu item.
- `:header` — inline context after the brand (switchers, etc.)
- `:inner_block` (required) — Main content column.
- `:sidebar` (required) — nav_group / nav_item
- `:sidebar_footer` — Persistent links pinned below the nav and above the collapse control (support, docs, legal).
- `:sidebar_header` — Top of the sidebar, above the nav groups: an org or workspace switcher, for example a dropdown.

#### `breadcrumb_bar/1`

Compact sticky breadcrumb region for use outside `app_shell` (or when the host app still owns the outer shell).

- `class` (:any) — Extra classes merged onto the root element.
- `id` (:string) — Stable id for the overflow menu when multi-entry actions collapse; auto-generated when omitted.
- `max_inline` (:integer, default 2) — How many entries render as quick buttons before the rest fold into the More menu.
- `rest` (:global) — Arbitrary HTML/`phx-*` attributes passed through.
Slots:
- `:actions` — Right-side actions.
  - `label` — Label used for this entry when it is collapsed into the overflow menu.
  - `phx-click` — LiveView click event on the overflow menu item.
  - `phx-value-id` — Optional phx-value-id for the overflow menu item.
  - `phx-target` — LiveView target for the overflow menu item.
  - `disabled` — Disable the overflow menu item.
  - `navigate` — Destination for a NAVIGATING entry.
  - `patch` — Live-patch destination for a folded navigating entry.
  - `href` — Plain href for a folded navigating entry.
  - `data-confirm` — Confirmation prompt for the folded menu item.
- `:inner_block` (required) — Usually a single <.breadcrumb>.

Slots:
- `:inner_block` (required) — nav_item children in this group.

- `title` (:string, required) — Current page label and semantic h1 text.

### LanternUI.Components.Select

#### `select/1`

Select — mirrors Fluxon's `select/1` surface: a `FormField`-aware select with a rich listbox path and a `native` fallback.

- `class` (:any) — Extra classes merged onto the root element.
- `clearable` (:boolean, default false) — show a clear (×) button that resets the selection (Fluxon parity).
- `controlled` (:boolean, default false) — server-driven mode: the server `value` is truth and patches flow into the Zag machine (non-searchable rich path only).
- `description` (:string) — Helper text under the label stack.
- `disabled` (:boolean, default false) — Render disabled and non-interactive.
- `errors` (:list, default []) — Validation messages; derived from field when used.
- `field` ({:struct, Phoenix.HTML.FormField}) — Form field; derives id, name, value, and errors.
- `help_text` (:string) — Trailing help line under the field when no errors.
- `id` (:any) — Element id.
- `include_hidden` (:boolean, default true) — Emit a blank hidden input so empty submits.
- `label` (:string) — Primary label above the control.
- `max` (:integer) — max selections when multiple
- `multiple` (:boolean, default false) — multi-select; submits name[] hidden inputs
- `name` (:any) — Form input name; derived from field when omitted.
- `native` (:boolean, default false) — Use a native <select> instead of the rich listbox.
- `on_change` (:string) — server event pushed with `%{id, value}` when the Zag select value changes (non-searchable rich path only).
- `on_change_client` (:string) — bubbling DOM CustomEvent dispatched with `%{id, value}` on Zag value changes (non-searchable rich path only).
- `options` (:list, default []) — Choices as values or {label, value} tuples.
- `placeholder` (:string, default "Select…") — Toggle text when nothing is selected.
- `prompt` (:string) — blank first option (native path)
- `rest` (:global) — Arbitrary HTML/`phx-*` attributes passed through.
- `search_input_placeholder` (:string, default "Search…") — Placeholder for the listbox search input.
- `search_no_results_text` (:string, default "No results") — Empty-state copy when search matches nothing.
- `search_threshold` (:integer) — auto-enable search at N+ options
- `searchable` (:boolean, default false) — search box inside the listbox
- `size` (:string, values: xs, sm, md, lg, xl, default "md") — Control density / type scale.
- `sublabel` (:string) — Secondary label line under the primary label.
- `value` (:any) — Selected value(s); list when multiple.

- `text` (:string) — Optional centered label on a horizontal rule.
- `vertical` (:boolean, default false) — Render a vertical divider instead of horizontal.

### LanternUI.Components.Sheet

Slide-over panel (drawer) that enters from a screen edge.

#### `sheet/1`

Slide-over panel (drawer) that enters from a screen edge.

- `animation` (:string) — Accepted for Fluxon compat; slide is token-driven.
- `animation_enter` (:string) — Accepted for Fluxon compat.
- `animation_leave` (:string) — Accepted for Fluxon compat.
- `backdrop_class` (:any) — Extra classes on the dimmed backdrop.
- `class` (:any) — Extra classes on the sliding panel.
- `close_on_esc` (:boolean, default true) — Close when Escape is pressed.
- `close_on_outside_click` (:boolean, default true) — Close when the backdrop is clicked.
- `container_class` (:any) — Extra classes on the overlay root.
- `controlled` (:boolean, default false) — Strict server-driven open state: `open` is truth, patches flow into the machine.
- `hide_close_button` (:boolean, default false) — Hide the built-in close control.
- `id` (:string, required) — Stable DOM id used by open_dialog/close_dialog.
- `on_change` (:string) — Server event pushed on open change (`lantern:dialog:open/close` replies).
- `on_change_client` (:string) — Bubbling DOM CustomEvent dispatched on open change.
- `on_close` ({:struct, Phoenix.LiveView.JS}) — JS command run when the sheet closes.

- `open` (:boolean, default false) — render already open (server-driven sheets)
- `placement` (:string, values: left, right, top, bottom, default "right") — Screen edge the panel slides in from.
- `prevent_closing` (:boolean, default false) — Block Escape and outside-click close.
- `rest` (:global) — Arbitrary HTML/`phx-*` attributes passed through.
- `title` (:string) — optional header title beside the close button
Slots:
- `:footer` — sticky footer (action buttons)
- `:header` — custom header content (replaces `title`)
- `:inner_block` (required) — Sheet body content.

### LanternUI.Components.Tabs

Tabs — segmented tab list + panels.

#### `tabs_list/1`

Tabs — segmented tab list + panels.

- `active_tab` (:string) — Name of the currently selected tab.
- `class` (:any) — Extra classes merged onto the root element.
- `controlled` (:boolean, default false) — Strict server-driven value even without `active_tab`.

- `on_change` (:string) — Server event pushed on selection (`lantern:tabs:set-value` replies).

- `rest` (:global) — Arbitrary HTML/`phx-*` attributes passed through.
- `size` (:string, values: sm, md, default "md") — Tab control density.
- `variant` (:string, values: segmented, underline, default "segmented") — segmented is pill-style; underline is text tabs.
Slots:
- `:inner_block` — Optional extra content inside the tab list.
- `:tab` (required) — One tab trigger; link via patch/navigate/href or button via phx-click.
  - `name` — Stable tab key; matched against active_tab.
  - `patch` — LiveView patch URL; renders the tab as a link.
  - `navigate` — LiveView navigate URL; renders the tab as a link.
  - `href` — External/full-page href; renders the tab as a link.
  - `disabled` — Disable this trigger.
  - `class` — Extra classes on this tab trigger.
  - `phx-click` — LiveView click event when not using patch/navigate.
  - `phx-value-tab` — phx-value-tab payload; defaults to name.
  - `phx-value-segment` — Legacy segmented alias payload; sent as params["segment"].
  - `phx-target` — LiveView target for the click event.

Tabs — segmented tab list + panels.

- `active` (:boolean, default false) — When true, the panel is rendered.
- `class` (:any) — Extra classes merged onto the root element.
- `name` (:string, required) — Tab key this panel belongs to.
- `rest` (:global) — Arbitrary HTML/`phx-*` attributes passed through.
Slots:
- `:inner_block` (required) — Panel body content.

### LanternUI.Components.Tooltip

Tooltip - mirrors Fluxon's `tooltip/1` API.

#### `tooltip/1`

Tooltip - mirrors Fluxon's `tooltip/1` API.

- `arrow` (:boolean, default true) — Show the small pointer arrow toward the trigger.
- `class` (:any) — Extra classes merged onto the root element.
- `controlled` (:boolean, default false) — Server-driven open state: `open` is truth, patches flow into the machine.
- `delay` (:integer, default 200) — Milliseconds before the tip appears on hover/focus.
- `id` (:string) — Stable DOM id for the tooltip hook; auto-generated when omitted, mirroring Fluxon's tooltip (drop-in parity).
- `on_change` (:string) — Server event pushed on open change (`lantern:tooltip:set-open` replies).
- `on_change_client` (:string) — Bubbling DOM CustomEvent dispatched on open change.
- `open` (:boolean) — Open state for `controlled` mode (client mode ignores it).
- `placement` (:string, values: top, bottom, left, right, default "top") — Preferred side of the trigger; may flip for viewport fit.
- `rest` (:global) — Arbitrary HTML/`phx-*` attributes passed through.
- `value` (:string) — Plain-text tip when no :content slot is given.
Slots:
- `:content` — Rich tip body; overrides `value` when present.
- `:inner_block` (required) — Trigger element that shows the tip.

### LanternUI.Components.Waterfall

Waterfall: horizontal spans laid out on ONE shared time axis, with a ruler.

#### `waterfall/1`

Waterfall: horizontal spans laid out on ONE shared time axis, with a ruler.

- `class` (:any) — Extra classes merged onto the root element.
- `id` (:string) — DOM id for the root element.
- `label` (:string) — Heading for the label column, rendered above the lane labels.
- `rest` (:global) — Arbitrary HTML/`phx-*` attributes passed through.
- `ticks` (:list, default []) — Shared axis ruler marks: a list of `%{label: string, pct: number}`, where `pct` is a percentage of the same axis lanes position against.
Slots:
- `:inner_block` (required) — One or more `waterfall_lane/1` children.

#### `waterfall_lane/1`

Waterfall: horizontal spans laid out on ONE shared time axis, with a ruler.

- `at` (:string) — Optional preformatted secondary line under the label; not formatted by the component.
- `bar_label` (:string) — Text inside (or beside) the bar, typically a preformatted duration.
- `class` (:any) — Extra classes merged onto the lane root.
- `label` (:string) — Lane name, shown in the fixed label column.
- `left` (:float, default 0.0) — Bar start as a percentage of the shared axis.
- `navigate` (:string) — When set, the whole lane is a navigation link.
- `patch` (:string) — When set, the whole lane is a patch link.
- `queued` (:boolean, default false) — Lane has no position on the axis yet.
- `rest` (:global) — Arbitrary HTML/`phx-*` attributes passed through.
- `selected` (:boolean, default false) — Marks this lane as the current selection.
- `state_label` (:string) — State word (e.g.
- `status` (:atom, values: done, active, pending, danger, warning, neutral, default :neutral) — Bar status, rendered as data-status for CSS coloring.
- `width` (:float, default 0.0) — Bar length as a percentage of the shared axis.
Slots:
- `:icon` — Optional glyph rendered before the label.
- `:inner_block` — Optional trailing content in the label column (badges, counts).

## Copy-paste recipes

From docs/recipes.md and README.md (same sources the recipe tests render).

From `docs/recipes.md` (Linear-style list row):

```heex
<.list_row
  identifier={@ticket.identifier}
  title={@ticket.title}
  parent={@ticket.parent}
  navigate={@ticket.href}
>
  <:leading>
    <.priority_glyph priority={@ticket.priority} />
    <.status_glyph status={@ticket.status} />
  </:leading>
  <:meta>
    <.badge size="sm">{@ticket.tag}</.badge>
    <.progress shape="ring" completed={@ticket.completed} scope={@ticket.scope} size="sm" />
  </:meta>
  <:trailing>{@ticket.date}</:trailing>
</.list_row>
```

From `docs/recipes.md` (Flat ticket list with toolbar):

```heex
<.data_table
  id="tickets"
  rows={@tickets}
  meta={@meta}
  path="/tickets"
  title="Tickets"
  fill
  views={["list"]}
  show_checkboxes={false}
  search_field={:title}
  data-lantern-list-nav
>
  <:filter
    field={:status}
    label="Status"
    options={[{"In progress (1)", "in_progress"}, {"To do (1)", "todo"}]}
    prompt="All statuses"
  />
  <:list_item :let={ticket}>
    <.list_row
      identifier={ticket.identifier}
      title={ticket.title}
      parent={ticket.parent}

    >

      </:leading>
      <:meta>
        <.badge size="sm">{ticket.tag}</.badge>
      </:meta>
      <:trailing>{ticket.date}</:trailing>

</.data_table>

```

From `README.md` (Skeleton placeholders):

```heex
<.button phx-click={LanternUI.open_dialog("delete-project")}>Delete…</.button>

<.alert_dialog id="delete-project">
  <:title>Delete this project?</:title>
  <:description>This permanently deletes the project and its data.</:description>
  <:cancel>
    <.button phx-click={LanternUI.close_dialog("delete-project")}>Cancel</.button>
  </:cancel>
  <:action>
    <.button color="danger" phx-click="delete-project">Delete project</.button>
  </:action>
</.alert_dialog>
```

From `README.md` (Autocomplete):

```heex
<.autocomplete field={@form[:country]} options={@countries} clearable />
```

From `README.md` (Autocomplete):

```heex
<.autocomplete
  field={@form[:user_id]}
  options={@user_results}
  on_search="search_users"
  search_threshold={2}
  debounce={250}
  open_on_focus
  clearable
>
  <:option :let={{name, id}}>
    <strong>{name}</strong> <small>#{id}</small>
  </:option>
  <:empty_state>No matching users</:empty_state>
</.autocomplete>
```

From `README.md` (Command palette):

```heex
<.command id="cmd-k" on_search="command_search" on_select="command_select">
  <.command_group label="Tickets">
    <.command_item :for={t <- @results} value={t.id}>
      {t.title}
      <:icon><.icon name="inbox" /></:icon>
      <:description>{t.project}</:description>
      <:shortcut>⏎</:shortcut>
    </.command_item>
  </.command_group>
  <.command_empty :if={@results == []}>No matches for “{@query}”</.command_empty>
  <:footer>↑↓ to navigate · ⏎ to select</:footer>
</.command>
```

## Overlaps and deprecations

Deprecated (warn at render; each entry names its planned removal version):

- `icon_button/1` is deprecated since 0.8.2; no removal is scheduled; use <.button size="icon" label="...">. Evidence: eval tasks 01/05 steer models to icon_button; same chrome as button/1.
- `segmented/1` is deprecated since 0.8.2; no removal is scheduled; use <.tabs_list variant="segmented">. Evidence: eval tasks 01 + brief steer models to segmented; duplicate filter-chip API.
- `progress_ring/1` is deprecated since 0.8.2; no removal is scheduled; use <.progress shape="ring" ...>. Evidence: duplicate of progress/1 shape="ring"; both in eval inventory.
- `property_row/1` is deprecated since 0.8.2; no removal is scheduled; use <.description_list layout="dense"> with <:item>. Evidence: eval task 03 steers models to property_row; same rows as dense description_list.
- `page_header/1` is deprecated since 0.10; removal planned for 1.0; use <.page_shell>. Evidence: shell contract 0.10: page_header draws a second visible title row under the breadcrumb; page_shell makes the breadcrumb the one title (docs/recipes.md Block 1).

Names models guess that never existed (the lint answers these with
did-you-mean):

- `stat` does not exist; use <.stat_card> for one metric, <.stat_grid> for a group. Evidence: baseline 2026-10-03 run notes (stat→stat_card prompt fix).
- `toast` does not exist; use <.toast_group> on the page + LanternUI.send_toast/3. Evidence: baseline 2026-10-03 run notes; eval tasks 02/05/08/09.

Not duplicates, do not merge: table/1 vs data_table/1 vs resource_list/1
are tiers (plain table, full list machinery, small index — see the page
design skill); modal/1 vs alert_dialog/1 vs sheet/1 are purposes
(general dialog, destructive confirm, edge panel); progress/1 covers bar
and ring via shape; tabs_list/1 covers segmented via variant.


## Tokens

Type scale: text-meta (11px), text-caption (12px), text-mono-meta.
Grey roles: text-foreground, text-foreground-soft, text-foreground-softest,
text-muted-foreground. Semantic: text-danger, bg-danger, text-success,
bg-success, text-warning, bg-warning. Components read --lantern-* CSS
variables chained to host tokens; see README theming and docs/scale.md.
Data-attribute behaviours (list keyboard nav, persist, collapse) install
on JS import; see docs/behaviours.md. Hooks bundle:
priv/static/lantern_ui_hooks.js.
